name: email.palisade/palisade-audit
title: Palisade Audit (no sign-in)
description: Audit any domain's SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS and BIMI from public DNS. No account, no sign-in.

tools.name: audit_domain
tools.description: Check the status of any domain's email authentication from live DNS in one call: MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI, MTA-STS and TLS-RPT, each with a verdict and the records behind it, plus a score out of 100. It answers questions such as "is DMARC set up on example.com", "how bad is this domain" or "what does this vendor publish". It takes a domain name and works on any domain. It reads public DNS only and writes nothing. Results are cached for ten minutes per domain, so a DNS change published seconds earlier does not show yet.

domain.description: The domain to audit, e.g. example.com.

tools.name: validate_spf_include
tools.description: Check whether a domain can be used as an SPF `include:` and how many DNS lookups adding it would cost. SPF fails permanently above 10 lookups, so this count, added to the lookup count of the record being changed, shows in advance whether a new sender fits. A domain that publishes no SPF record, or more than one, cannot be included at all and comes back valid false with the reason. Reads live DNS and changes nothing.

domain.description: The include target to test, e.g. _spf.google.com.
